string-array.name: import_keepass_steps
string-array.item: In KeePassXC, open Database, then Export, and choose XML file. In KeePass 2, open File, then Export, and choose KeePass XML (2.x).
Save the file. It isn\'t protected, so keep it somewhere private.
Choose the file here. Entries that have a one-time password are brought across.

resources.string: Delete the export once the import is done: it holds every password in the database in the clear. The database file itself (.kdbx) can\'t be read here.
